subject: Discovery call recap + next steps (Aurora Systems)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Kumar <sanjay.kumar@aurora-systems.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery call recap + next steps (Aurora Systems)

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery: 

- Goal: Reduce latency on your customer support reranking pipeline while cutting per-token inference spend by ~30%.
- Current setup: In-house LLM endpoints on single-GPU instances, ~120ms p90 latency, limited horizontal scale.
- Constraints: Must keep PII out of logs; prefer VPC/private deployment for procurement reasons.
- Success metrics you mentioned: p90 < 80ms for inference, 30% cost reduction, and stable throughput for batch re-ranks during spikes.

What we can do for Aurora Systems (high level):
- Redwood Dedicated to reserve capacity + predictable throughput, with private deployment option for audit controls.
- Intelligent batching + KV cache to lower per-token cost for reranking workloads.
- Dedicated on-prem / VPC option with KMS integration for key management.

Attached: a short discovery recap + initial pricing ranges for Dedicated (ballpark) — see "Redwood_Discovery_Recap.pdf" and our standard pricing summary (redwood-pricing.pdf).

Suggested next steps:
1) If this aligns, we can schedule a 45-minute technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer to discuss integration details and a proof-of-concept scope.
2) I can put together a mutual action plan and a dedicated capacity proposal based on your expected Q3 traffic profile.

Would Wednesday or Thursday next week work for the deep-dive? If you prefer, send over a couple times and I’ll coordinate.

Best,

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Just wanted to bump this in case it got buried. Quick reminder of the suggested next steps:

If budget/priority has shifted, no worries — a one-line update on timing would help so we don’t spam you. Would love to get a slot on your calendar if this is still a priority.

Subject: Quick check — still interested in a technical deep-dive?

Hey Sanjay —

Bumping this for one last check-in this week. If Aurora’s priorities have shifted, totally understand — could you let me know if now / next quarter / not a fit?

If it helps, here are two short options for next steps that require minimal time: 
- 30-min technical sync (we bring our solutions engineer) — confirm a time and we’ll send calendar invite.
- Quick written AMPL (2–3 bullets) we can use to scope a small POC and show estimated cost/latency gains.

If I don’t hear back, I’ll close the outreach thread and check back in after your Q2 planning. Appreciate any quick signal on timing.

Thanks —
Marissa
